name: Maxspect XF330CE Gyre
protocol_notes: Device uses 0x0091 push frames instead of 0x0094 poll responses. Status payload is 1044 bytes. See MAXSPECT_PROTOCOL.md for full details.

attrs.name: MinSpeed
attrs.desc: Min speed percentage at offset 0x2B (43). Observed value: 10. NOT YET CONFIRMED via targeted test.

attrs.name: MaxSpeed
attrs.desc: Max speed percentage at offset 0x2C (44). Observed value: 68 (0x44). NOT YET CONFIRMED via targeted test.

attrs.name: Mode
attrs.desc: Operating mode at offset 0x2D (45). Observed value: 5. Possibly: 0=constant, 5=alternating. NOT YET CONFIRMED.

attrs.name: Interval
attrs.desc: Wave interval at offset 0x2F (47). Observed value: 10. NOT YET CONFIRMED.

attrs.name: CH1_RPM
attrs.desc: Channel 1 motor RPM at offset 0x399 (921). uint16 big-endian. Range: 0-3000. Returned as hex, decode with int(value, 16).

attrs.name: CH1_Voltage
attrs.desc: Channel 1 supply voltage at offset 0x39B (923). uint16 big-endian. Value / 100 = volts (e.g. 2408 = 24.08V).

attrs.name: CH1_Power
attrs.desc: Channel 1 power consumption at offset 0x39E (926). Value in watts.

attrs.name: CH2_RPM
attrs.desc: Channel 2 motor RPM at offset 0x3A2 (930). uint16 big-endian. Range: 0-3000.

attrs.name: CH2_Voltage
attrs.desc: Channel 2 supply voltage at offset 0x3A4 (932). uint16 big-endian. Value / 100 = volts.

attrs.name: CH2_Power
attrs.desc: Channel 2 power consumption at offset 0x3A7 (935). Value in watts.

attrs.name: Timestamp
attrs.desc: Device timestamp at offset 0x22 (34). 6 bytes: YY MM DD HH MM SS.

attrs.name: DeviceID
attrs.desc: Device ID at offset 0x15 (21). 12 bytes ASCII: G3C1A0005968.

attrs.name: ModeBlock
attrs.desc: Mode/program definition block at offset 0x66 (102). Variable length (49-53 bytes observed). First byte is length. Contains speed pairs and program definitions. See MAXSPECT_PROTOCOL.md §5.2.
